title.zh: CPU 是怎么算小数的，又怎么一次算一排
title.en: How a CPU Does Math: Real Numbers, and Many at Once

desc.zh: 一块 CPU 每秒做几千亿次小数运算，却连 0.1 都存不准。这篇从 32 个位讲起：浮点数的位怎么排，ulp，舍入，次正规数，抵消，FMA，AI 带进硬件的 FP16、BF16、FP8 和块缩放格式，再到 SIMD、AVX-512、SVE 和矩阵单元。十几个可以动手的模型，数都是逐位算出来的。
desc.en: A CPU does hundreds of billions of arithmetic operations on fractions every second, yet it cannot even store 0.1 exactly. This essay starts from 32 bits: how the bits of a floating-point number are laid out, ulps, rounding, subnormals, cancellation, FMA, the FP16, BF16, FP8 and block-scaled formats AI brought into hardware, and then SIMD, AVX-512, SVE and matrix units. A dozen hands-on models, every number computed bit by bit.

title.zh: 浮点数的三段位：符号、指数、尾数
title.en: The three fields of a float: sign, exponent, significand

desc.zh: 浮点数是二进制的科学计数法：1 位符号，8 位带偏移的指数，23 位尾数加一个不存的隐藏位。输入任何数，看它被存成哪些位、差了多少。
desc.en: A float is binary scientific notation: one sign bit, a biased 8-bit exponent and a 23-bit significand with a hidden leading 1. Type any number and see its bits and its error.

zh: 符号位 指数位 尾数位

title.zh: ulp：浮点数的格子越往外越稀
title.en: ulp: floats get sparser as they grow

desc.zh: 每过一个 2 的幂，相邻两个浮点数的间隔就宽一倍：绝对误差随大小增长，相对误差大致不变。float 能连续数到 16,777,216。
desc.en: Past every power of two the gap between neighbouring floats doubles: absolute error grows with size while relative error stays roughly fixed. A float counts integers only up to 16,777,216.

zh: float 能精确表示的最大整数

title.zh: 舍入模式：落在两格之间怎么选
title.en: Rounding modes: choosing between two neighbours

desc.zh: 就近取偶、向零、向正负无穷和随机舍入，五条线比较同一个数加很多次的结果；低精度累加为什么会停滞。
desc.en: Round to nearest even, toward zero, toward ±infinity and stochastic rounding, compared by adding the same number many times; why low-precision sums stall.

zh: 保护位 舍入位 粘滞位

title.zh: 次正规数、无穷大和 NaN

desc.zh: 指数全 0 是零和次正规数，让数一点点下溢到零；全 1 是无穷大和 NaN。拖一个数往零走，看它丢掉有效位，以及冲零模式怎么做。
desc.en: An all-zero exponent holds zero and subnormals, so numbers underflow gradually; all ones holds infinity and NaN. Walk a number toward zero and watch it lose bits, with and without flush-to-zero.

title.zh: 灾难性抵消与求和算法

desc.zh: 两个相近的数相减，前面的位抵消，误差被推到最前面：一遍法算方差会得出负数。顺序求和、两两求和与 Kahan 补偿求和的误差比较。
desc.en: Subtracting two close numbers cancels the leading digits and promotes the error: a one-pass variance can come out negative. Naive, pairwise and Kahan compensated summation compared.

title.en: FMA: multiply and add with one rounding

desc.zh: a × b + c 先算准确的积再加，只在最后舍入一次。它让 x*x − y*y 在 x = y 时可能得出负数，对点积的精度帮助却不大。
desc.en: a × b + c computed with the exact product and one final rounding. It can make x*x − y*y negative when x = y, yet barely changes the accuracy of a dot product.

title.zh: FP16、BF16 和 8 位浮点：为 AI 砍掉的位
title.en: FP16, BF16 and 8-bit floats: bits cut for AI

desc.zh: 同样 16 位，FP16 多给尾数，BF16 保住 binary32 的范围。把一组数放进各种格式，看多少下溢、多少溢出；各格式的范围和精度表。
desc.en: With the same 16 bits, FP16 favours precision and BF16 keeps the range of binary32. Put a spread of values into each format and see how many underflow or overflow; a table of ranges and precisions.

title.en: INT8 and block scaling: MX and NVFP4

desc.zh: 低位数的数配一个共同的比例。整个张量一个比例，离群值会把其余的数压没；OCP MX 每 32 个数一个 8 位比例。七种量化方式的信噪比比较。
desc.en: Few-bit values share a common scale. With one scale per tensor an outlier crushes everything else; OCP MX gives every 32 values an 8-bit scale. Seven quantisation schemes compared by signal-to-noise ratio.

title.zh: SIMD：一条指令算一排，以及掩码
title.en: SIMD: one instruction, many lanes, and masks

desc.zh: 宽寄存器切成很多条车道，一条指令每条车道做同一件事；判断变成掩码。从 SSE 到 AVX-512，看车道数、掩码和循环尾部。
desc.en: A wide register split into lanes, one instruction doing the same thing in every lane; branches become masks. From SSE to AVX-512: lanes, mask bits and the loop tail.

title.zh: 自动向量化与求和顺序

desc.zh: 编译器只在能证明结果不变时才向量化；浮点加法不满足结合律，所以求和默认不向量化。对齐、步长、gather，以及多车道求和为什么结果会变。
desc.en: A compiler vectorises only what it can prove unchanged; float addition is not associative, so sums are not vectorised by default. Alignment, strides, gather, and why a multi-lane sum changes the result.

zh: 结构体数组 数组结构体
en: array of structs vs struct of arrays

title.zh: 乘加的延迟、吞吐和宽向量降频
title.en: FMA latency, throughput and wide-vector clocks

desc.zh: 延迟 4 拍、每拍两条，要 8 个累加器才喂得满；峰值算力怎么算。AVX-512 的频率许可让一小段向量代码拖慢后面将近一毫秒。
desc.en: Four cycles of latency and two per cycle need eight accumulators; how peak FLOPS is computed. AVX-512 frequency licences let a short vector burst slow the next millisecond of code.

title.zh: SVE、SME 和 AMX：不定宽的向量与矩阵单元
title.en: SVE, SME and AMX: length-agnostic vectors and matrix units

desc.zh: 同一份 SVE 程序在 128 到 2048 位的硬件上都能跑；矩阵单元用外积一次做 n² 次乘加。苹果 M4 的 SME 和英特尔 AMX。
desc.en: One SVE binary runs on hardware from 128 to 2048 bits; matrix units do n² multiply-adds per outer product. SME on Apple M4 and Intel AMX.

title.zh: CPU 数值计算的前沿（2026 年 11 月）

desc.zh: 已经确立的标准、已经做出来的芯片、厂商的规范和说法：AVX10.2 的 FP8 与随机舍入、Arm SME2、IEEE P3109 草案。
desc.en: Established standards, shipped chips, and vendor specifications and claims: FP8 and stochastic rounding in AVX10.2, Arm SME2, the IEEE P3109 draft.
